g.text: Bulks of one cell type, per cell, weighted by the composition
Fill: exact density of sum_j p_j N(mu_j, R_j), R_j = Sigma_W,j / n, not the bulk law.
Outlines: 95% regions of a bulk of n cells of one type; points: centroids
(cell type 1: red circle, solid outline; cell type 2: green triangle, dashed outline).
